findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Command Injection Search
 * @description Detects usage of subprocess and os command execution functions.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/command-injection-search
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "check_call", "check_output", "run", "Popen"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen", "spawnl", "spawnle", "spawnlp", "spawnlpe", "spawnv", "spawnve", "spawnvp", "spawnvpe"]).getACall()
select call, "Potential command execution found."
findings.hypothesis: The package might execute system commands, potentially leading to command injection if inputs are not sanitized.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Command Execution Check
 * @description Check for command execution sinks and their arguments in cli.py
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/command-exec-check
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call.getLocation().getFile().getShortName() = "cli.py" and
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["run", "call", "check_call", "check_output", "Popen"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Command execution found. Args: " + call.getArg(0).toString()
findings.hypothesis: Investigate the nature of the command execution found in the previous step.

message.text: Command execution found. Args: ControlFlowNode for command

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Subprocess Shell Argument Check
 * @description Checks if subprocess calls have shell=True
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/subprocess-shell-check
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, DataFlow::ExprNode shellArg
where
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["run", "call", "Popen", "check_call", "check_output"]).getACall() and
  (
    shellArg = call.getArgByName("shell")
    or
    // Check if shell is passed as a positional argument (less likely for run/Popen but possible)
    // run(args, ..., shell=...)
    exists(int i | shellArg = call.getArg(i) and i > 0) // Heuristic, usually shell is kwarg
  )
select call, "Subprocess call with shell argument: " + shellArg.asExpr().toString()
findings.hypothesis: Subprocess call might be using shell=True, enabling command injection.

message.text: Subprocess call with shell argument: False
